videos.script: Until now, the code Ana edits is the code the nightly runs. Every save is live. {{live}} So the project goes into git. Code in; data, secrets and what is made by running, out. {{git}} Two targets, two sets of schemas. And production is a tag, checked out on its own. {{envs}} A change on a branch, built beside production, and compared. Two thousand seven hundred rows differ. {{compare}} initcap capitalised every word. Five categories renamed, and nobody asked. {{caught}} The second try changes nothing today, which is the point. {{fixed}} Tests, merge, a tag, a deploy. And a rollback to a version that can be returned to.
